services.name: Kids Karate
services.desc: Our Kids Karate program is designed for children ages 4-12 at every experience level. Classes blend karate fundamentals with an intentional, consistent emphasis on the life skills that make a lasting difference: improved focus, growing confidence, and self-discipline that shows up in the classroom, at home, and everywhere in between. The energy of karate - the movement, the kicks, the sense of progress - is what keeps kids engaged and excited to come back. And while they’re having fun, our instructors are actively reinforcing the habits and mindsets that matter most for their development. It’s not a side benefit. It’s the point. services.name: Kids Birthday Parties
services.desc: Give your child a birthday party that’s anything but ordinary. Marietta Martial Arts hosts karate birthday parties for kids ages 4-10 - a high-energy, instructor-led celebration held right here at our Sandy Plains location in Marietta. It’s a fun, active alternative to traditional party venues, with the energy and excitement of martial arts built right in. Parties are available for families in the Marietta area. This is a hands-on, on-site experience - guests don’t just watch, they participate.
